public static class Pricing
{
    public static int Total(int[] items, bool vip)
    {
        var total = 0;
        foreach (var i in items)
        {
            if (i > 0 && !vip) { total += i * 2; }
        }
        try { Check(total); } catch (InvalidOperationException e) { Log(e.Message); }
        try { Check(total); } catch { Log("x"); }
        return total;
    }
}
